notes: New: HTTPS, the padlock in the browser, ON from the start: your password and everything else to the map is encrypted
Change it in Settings → Secure connection: private certificate (the default), Let's Encrypt for your own domain, or plain http
The first time on each device the browser warns: download the map's certificate in Settings and install it once (steps there)
The map can be opened by a name like flightmap.home, and the old http address keeps working: it sends you to the secure one
If HTTPS ever locks you out: bash /opt/dji-flightmap/deploy/set-https.sh --off (see the README)
